hooks.name: block-forbidden-files
hooks.description: Reject writes to .env, appsettings.Production.json, rbac_policy.csv, and hand-edited migration files.

hooks.name: block-destructive-commands
hooks.description: Reject rm -rf outside safe paths, git push --force, and database updates against non-dev connections.

hooks.name: verify-migration-shape
hooks.description: After a 'dotnet ef migrations add' command, verify the generated migration has both Up and Down methods.

hooks.name: secret-pattern-scan
hooks.description: Scan the new/edited content for common secret patterns and refuse if matched.
